title: Ars Magna Power Patron
summary: Ars Magna is a five-card engine built around Power Patron Link Monsters, so this list follows the page's reference shell converted to TCG legality: Ars Magna paired with Medius the Pure, the Power Patrons, and the Elfnote center-zone opener.

summary.title: Starters
points: Elfnote Lucina Special Summons itself to the center Main Monster Zone and searches an Elfnote monster such as Elfnote Regina.

Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification banishes itself from the hand to search Ars Magna "Citrinitas" (Elfnote Tinia, which placed Citrinitas straight from the Deck, is Forbidden since October 2026).
Medius the Pure adds or Special Summons a Power Patron monster from the Deck when Normal or Special Summoned, and Prohibited Power Patron Portal - Terminus dumps a Power Patron to search Medius.

summary.title: Opening: Elfnote Opener into Power Patron Links
steps: Special Summon Elfnote Lucina to the center zone to search Elfnote Regina, then banish Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification from the hand to search Ars Magna "Citrinitas" and activate it.
Use Citrinitas (or Theorealize Past Lull while an Elfnote card is face-up) to search and Special Summon Medius the Pure without allowing opposing responses.
Medius summons a Power Patron to Link Climb through Purification Power Patron (searching Theorealized Medius) into the Link-3 boss Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron.

Banish Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite and Division and the Union from your hand for their setup effects (Corruption and the Purification is already banished), and return all three to the field as Fusion, Synchro, Xyz and Link Patrons arrive.

summary.title: The Ars Magna Engine & Citrinitas
summary.text: Each of the three Ars Magna monsters banishes itself from the hand for a setup effect—Finite and the Infinite searches a non-Warrior Ars Magna and triples your Power Patron Links' ATK (turning Mediclius into a 9000 ATK tower), Corruption and the Purification searches an Ars Magna Spell/Trap, and Division and the Union revives an Ars Magna—then Special Summons itself back from banishment when a matching Extra Deck monster type (Fusion/Link, Xyz/Link, or Synchro/Link) is summoned. While you control a Power Patron Link Monster (Mediclius or Purification Power Patron), Ars Magna "Citrinitas" upgrades all Ars Magna monster effects into Quick Effects on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron (Link-3) activates Citrinitas and reaches 9000 ATK under Finite and the Infinite.
Ars Magna "Philosophorum" banishes face-up Ars Magna cards from your field or GY to negate that many cards on the field, and banishes itself from the GY to revive a Power Patron Link Monster.
Nervedo, Jupredo and Junoldo transform into Nerva (Fusion), Jupiter (Xyz) and Junora (Synchro), setting up Vidolium the Unstable Power Patron of Unity to banish both GYs.
The Great Gallant Bandit is the reference shell's Normal Summon floodgate, negating activated monster effects in the hand, GY and banishment while Normal Summoned.

summary.title: TCG Adjustments
summary.text: Unleashed Power Patron Portal - Terminus is localized as Prohibited Power Patron Portal - Terminus and Limited to 1 in the TCG, Elfnote Tinia is Forbidden (October 2026), and Baronne de Fleur is Forbidden.

allow.Elfnote Lucina: The reference shell's opener: summons itself to the center zone and searches an Elfnote monster.
allow.Elfnote Regina: Reference shell: pulls another Elfnote from the Deck in the center zone.
allow.Elfnote Seraphim Strelitzia: Elfnote Synchro that Elfnote Power Patron and the Level 6 Elfnotes reach.

main: Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite
Newest support. Banishes itself to search a non-Warrior Ars Magna and triple your Power Patron Links' ATK; returns when a Fusion or Link arrives.
Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification
Newest support. Banishes itself to search an Ars Magna Spell/Trap; returns when an Xyz or Link arrives, and banishes Spells/Traps.
Ars Magna the Division and the Union
Newest support. Banishes itself to revive another Ars Magna; returns when a Synchro or Link arrives, and draws.
Ars Magna "Citrinitas"
Newest support. With a Power Patron Link out, Ars Magna effects become Quick Effects; searches a Medius or Ars Magna monster.
Ars Magna "Philosophorum"
Newest support. Banishes Ars Magnas to negate that many cards; from the GY, revives a Power Patron Link.
Elfnote Lucina
Summons itself to the center zone and searches an Elfnote monster.
Elfnote Regina
Summons itself on either turn; in the center zone, summons an Elfnote from the Deck.
Elfnote Power Patron
Raises the center monster's Level by 3 and Synchro Summons on the spot.
Medius the Pure
Summoned: adds or summons a Power Patron monster from the Deck.
Theorealized Medius
Counts as Power Patron: summons itself and searches a Theorealize card; finds Ars Magna when a monster is banished.
Theorealize Past Lull
With an Elfnote card out, summons Medius with no response.
Prohibited Power Patron Portal - Terminus
Limited. Sends a Power Patron to the GY and searches a DARK Fairy such as Medius.
Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron
Becomes Nerva; face-up in the Extra Deck, summons a Power Patron.
Jupredo the Shademachine Power Patron
Becomes Jupiter; face-up in the Extra Deck, searches a Power Patron Spell/Trap.
Junoldo the Shadespirit Power Patron
Becomes Junora; face-up in the Extra Deck, returns a Power Patron card.
Vidolium the Unstable Power Patron of Unity
Returns a Fusion, Synchro and Xyz to summon itself and banish both GYs.
The Great Gallant Bandit
Generic: the shell's pick over situational hand traps; negates hand, GY and banishment effects while Normal Summoned.
extra: Power Patron Link-3: the 9000 ATK payoff that makes Citrinitas live.
Power Patron Link-2: searches a Theorealize card and Link Summons again.
Nerva the Power Patron of Creation
Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction
Junora the Power Patron of Tuning
Synchro Patron that Junoldo or Elfnote Power Patron makes.
Level 7 Synchro: revives a Level 6 Elfnote and shrinks Levels for the next Synchro.
Link-2: banishes a card on the field/GY on summon and banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
